example.question: Compare the headline liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) as reported for 2025 by Belfius Bank (its LCR 'at the end of 2025') with the LCR reported by Luzerner Kantonalbank (Group) in its 31 December 2025 key metrics table. Which was higher?
example.reference_answer: Belfius Bank reported an LCR of 144% at the end of 2025, while Luzerner Kantonalbank (Group) reported an LCR of 129.69% in its 31.12.2025 key metrics column (148.44% at 31 December 2024).
